title: A React Native foundation with the gate already wired
description: Expo with Expo Router, React Native, TypeScript strict, NativeWind on Tailwind, Jest with Testing Library — plus the hooks, CI and agent flow that keep a fork honest from the first commit.
seed: This screen is the template seed: replace it with the first real screen and keep the sections you still need.

inside.title: What's inside
inside.expo: Expo with file-based routing, typed routes and Continuous Native Generation
inside.react: React Native with the React Compiler on, so manual memoisation stays out
inside.typescript: TypeScript strict with type-aware ESLint and an oxlint pre-pass
inside.styling: NativeWind on Tailwind tokens: className only, no StyleSheet
inside.state: Zustand for client state, TanStack Query for server state
inside.env: Zod-validated env: nothing reads process.env directly
inside.i18n: i18next with bundled namespaces and typed keys
inside.testing: Jest with Testing Library, StrykerJS on a weekly schedule, Maestro flows for native pixels

iterate.title: Iterate
iterate.text: Per change, seconds: oxlint, tsc and the changed tests. Nothing heavier.

commit.title: Commit
commit.text: The pre-commit hook does the work: staged autofix, the TDD sibling gate, the repo-wide cheap checks, the docs check when docs are staged.

push.title: Push
push.text: The pre-push hook runs the gate once: the audit gate plus every offline check. No build and no e2e stage sit in this gate.

ci.title: CI
ci.text: The same chain, plus what only CI can do: the security workflow, dependency review, the weekly docs check and the weekly mutation score.

agents.title: Agent flow
agents.lead: One file every tool reads. Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot all start from it; the brain files it points at hold the depth.

commands.onboard: read the brain, verify it against the code, report drift, stop
commands.feat: reuse check, scope, plan, test-first, gate, report
commands.test: tests that hunt corner cases at the seams, not the happy path
commands.review: senior review of the diff: leaks, security, bug hunt
commands.docs: bring the guide and the brain back in line with the code

agents.spec: Anything bigger than a one-sentence diff starts with a spec and a plan, copied from the templates folder, reviewed before the first edit.

reading.title: Where to read
reading.index: a situation mapped to the two or three files that answer it
reading.map: entry points, state boundaries, the route table
reading.skeletons: danger zones: files where a wrong edit breaks the app silently or in production only
reading.verification: what to run per kind of change
reading.decisions: why the stack is the way it is, with dates and revisit triggers
reading.security: the static security review: scope, findings, what must stay out of the bundle

steps.title: First steps
steps.prepare: installs the git hooks; lifecycle scripts are off by design
steps.dev: starts the Expo dev server; scan the QR with Expo Go
steps.iter: the iteration tier, run per change
